# Jose Ramon Martinez Saavedra

> Builds deployable quantum-randomness infrastructure for cybersecurity, high-performance computing, and post-quantum systems. VP of Innovation and Lead Scientist at Quside Technologies.

## Summary

Co-inventor across 8 patent families (US, EP, CN, JP). PI of EUR 5.6M+ in competitive R&D funding (Horizon Europe/EIC, CDTI). 30+ patent families under management. PhD in Photonics (UPC/ICFO). MBA (Valar Institute).
